Could you confirm a collection vehicle can take all four together? We cannot release a partial consignment.
Please confirm capacity for all four cartons on OF-036: each 40 × 30 × 25 cm, 5 kg; total 20 kg. Request collection 2026-03-10 from 10:00 UTC, dispatch door S1. Accept A–D as one manifest.
Booking COL-036 confirmed for 2026-03-10, 10:00–12:00 UTC. Capacity reserved for all four cartons, 20 kg total. Inline accepted manifest MN-036 lists DL-036-A, B, C and D. Pickup has not occurred.
Final weigh before sealing: cartons A, B and C are 5 kg each, carton D is 8 kg. Total 23 kg, not the 20 kg on our packing list. Dimensions are unchanged.

Two weights now exist for OF-036. Manifest MN-036 records 20 kg. The shipper's final weigh before sealing gives 23 kg: cartons A, B and C at 5 kg each and carton D at 8 kg, dimensions unchanged. Please confirm the manifest weight on record and whether the capacity reserved under COL-036 covers 23 kg.

MN-036 recorded 20 kg. On the shipper's final weigh we have amended it to 23 kg, with carton D at 8 kg. The capacity reserved under COL-036 covers 23 kg. Pickup has not occurred, and the weights are not yet checked at collection.
